title: Bank Ki Galti Se Cheque Expire? SC Ka Order #shorts

source.title: Canara Bank v. Kavita Chowdhary — Supreme Court of India (2026 INSC 363, Civil Appeal No. 2587 of 2025)

hook.caption: Bank ki laparwahi se aapka cheque expire ho gaya? Ab bank ko khud apni jeb se muawza dena padega!
hook.tts: Bank की लापरवाही से आपका cheque expire हो गया? अब bank को खुद जेब से पैसा देना पड़ेगा!

doc.name: SC Judgment · 2026 INSC 363
doc.caption: Supreme Court Judgment (15 Apr 2026): Canara Bank vs Kavita Chowdhary — ₹1.06 crore ke do cheques ka case.
doc.tts: यह है Supreme Court का judgment, Canara Bank versus Kavita Chowdhary, एक करोड़ छह लाख रुपये के cheques का मामला.

points.title: Bank Customer Ka Agent Hai
points.quote: A bank receiving cheques for collection acts as an agent of the customer and is under an obligation to exercise due diligence in presenting the instruments within the prescribed validity period.
points.decoded: Cheque lene ke baad bank customer ka agent — time pe present karna farz
points.caption: Point 1: Cheque jama lete hi bank customer ka agent ban jaata hai. Validity se pehle present karna uski duty hai — par agar bank chook jaaye toh?
points.tts: पहला point. Cheque जमा लेते ही bank customer का agent बन जाता है और उसकी ज़िम्मेदारी है समय पर cheque present करना. लेकिन अगर वह चूक जाए तो?

points.title: Stale Cheque = Deficiency in Service
points.quote: Failure to do so resulting in the instrument becoming stale, in the absence of any reasonable explanation, would result in negligence in the discharge of banking duties which would constitute deficiency in rendering service within the meaning of the consumer protection law.
points.decoded: Bina thos wajah cheque stale = Consumer Law mein Deficiency in Service
points.caption: Yahi sabse bada twist hai: cheque stale hone se customer Section 138 NI Act ka case bhi kho baitha. SC ne ise seedha Deficiency in Service mana!
points.tts: यहीं सबसे बड़ा twist है! Cheque expire होने से customer Section एक सौ अड़तीस का केस भी नहीं कर पाई, जिसे Supreme Court ने साफ़ deficiency in service माना.

points.title: 6% Muawza + 6% Interest
points.quote: In our view, having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, compensation assessed at 6 percent of the total amount of Rs, 1,06,10,768.00 to each of the complainants alongwith interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of filing the complaints would be a reasonable compensation and thereby meet the ends of justice.
points.decoded: SC ne 10% badal ke 6% muawza + 6% yearly interest tay kiya
points.caption: Point 3: NCDRC ne 10% penalty lagayi thi; SC ne loss indeterminate hone par 6% of ₹1,06,10,768 plus 6% yearly interest dene ka aadesh diya.
points.tts: तीसरा point. NCDRC ने दस percent मुआवज़ा दिया था, जिसे Supreme Court ने बदलकर पूरे एक करोड़ छह लाख पर छह percent मुआवज़ा और छह percent सालाना ब्याज तय किया.

seo.description:
Supreme Court (Canara Bank v. Kavita Chowdhary, 2026 INSC 363): Bank ki negligence se cheque expire hona Deficiency in Service hai — 6% compensation + 6% interest!
Official SC Judgment PDF: https://api.sci.gov.in/supremecourt/2024/50187/50187_2024_7_1501_70151_Judgement_15-Apr-2026.pdf
Comment 'FAIR?' if 6% was enough. #SupremeCourt #ConsumerRights #BankingLaw #ChequeBounce #Unpaper
seo.caption:
Bank ki laparwahi se cheque expire ho gaya? ⚖️🏦 Supreme Court (Canara Bank v. Kavita Chowdhary, 2026 INSC 363) ka bada faisla:
1️⃣ Cheque lene par bank customer ka agent hota hai
2️⃣ Bina wajah cheque stale = Deficiency in Service
3️⃣ Canara Bank par ₹1.06 Cr cheques ka 6% muawza + 6% interest

Save karo & share karo! #SupremeCourt #ConsumerRights #BankingLaw #ChequeBounce #Unpaper

viralBlueprint.outlierAngle: Customers assume bank strikes or connectivity issues excuse delayed cheque clearing; SC held banks strictly liable as agents for stale cheques, even reducing NCDRC's 10% to 6% on ₹1.06 Cr.
